darkBrown.usage: Primary brand color. Main text, headings, borders, nav backgrounds, interactive element backgrounds. The dominant color of the brand.

cream.usage: Secondary accent. Borders, chip backgrounds on hover, subtle dividers.

white.usage: Primary default content background. Text on dark surfaces. Slightly warm white.

textDark.usage: Default body text color on light backgrounds.

skin.usage: Warm background for sections, cards, and inner container fills.

lightBrown.usage: Secondary text, labels, meta information, muted UI elements.

lightPink.usage: Card borders, chip resting background, subtle interactive states.

subtitle.usage: Secondary heading text on light backgrounds.

deepWine.usage: Deep wine. Used in gradient stops, brand-mark background rect, double-chevron arrow toggle. Rarely a surface color — prefer #5D3136 for frames.

brownGradient.usage: SVG fills for display title text, hero section gradients.

themeTokens.note: Used for card/section themes. Each theme must define background, title, dots, and border.

paper.title: #5D3136
paper.usage: Flat paper-like surface. Use only when a cleaner, sharper contrast than the warm default is intentionally needed.
